body.message:
Apologies if blocking for 3 month this will be the process

As per your request, please find below the rates for MAG318, Business Bay – Studio Apartment:

August: AED 5,100
September: AED 6,100
October: AED 7,100

Total: AED 18,300 for 90 nights

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 1,500 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

To confirm and secure the 3-month booking, the first month’s rent, at least half of the last month’s rent, and the security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we can reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
